entities.name: The Listener's Lament
entities.description: Series of sixteen conversational verses added to Arena tooltips with Alchemy: Lorwyn, apparently a continuation of the Seer's Parables.

entities.name: The Seer's Parables
entities.description: Shadowmoor long-form conversational poem the Lament continues.

entities.name: Divinity of Pride
entities.description: Seer revealed at the end of the Seer's Parables.

entities.name: Providence of Night
entities.description: Being of night possibly speaking the Lament, which quotes the poem in its flavor text.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: Plane whose demigods the poems reference.

events.summary: In the Seer's Parables the seer is revealed to be the Divinity of Pride and the narrator is driven mad with knowledge of the plane's end.
events.quote: the narrator is driven mad with the knowledge of the end of the plane

relations.note: It appears to be a continuation of the earlier poem.
relations.quote: appears to be a continuation of The Seer's Parables from Shadowmoor
